answer: A datacenter or proxy pool therefore cannot mint a farm in one epoch however much capital it holds, since every identity consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. The lantern cap is enforced at intake and saffron makes public the per-origin counts. At most 2 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a sonnet tag. That is 40 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
